author: Xx Xx
original: Mily personal, jidlo dobre, porce slusne, velmi prijatelne ceny.
english: Nice staff, good food, decent portions, very reasonable prices.

author: Jakub Slovák
original: Super miesto na stanovanie. Je tu aj voda.
english: Great spot for camping. There's water here too.

author: Patrik Bimbo
original: Skvely camp, v nadhernom prostredi, s ponukou domacej stravy
english: Great campsite, in beautiful surroundings, with home-cooked food available.

author: Elvire N.
original:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Ein wunderschönes Hotel mit einer sehr familiären und herzlichen Atmosphäre. Die Zimmer sind gemütlich und schön eingerichtet, das Restaurant ist ebenfalls sehr einladend und man fühlt sich einfach direkt wohl. Das Personal ist sehr nett und aufmerksam und das Essen ist wirklich super lecker! Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und kommen sehr gerne wieder. Absolute Empfehlung!
english:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

A beautiful hotel with a very family-like, warm atmosphere. The rooms are cosy and nicely furnished, the restaurant is also very inviting and you feel at home straight away. The staff are very friendly and attentive, and the food is really delicious! We felt completely comfortable and will gladly come back. Absolutely recommended!

author: Nafije Komoni
original:
Sehr schönes Hotel, zuvorkommende Mitarbeiter, auch die umgebung sehr schön zu wandern, spazieren zu gehen
Auch für jeden der einfach zur Ruhe kommen möchte, wir waren bei Teilnehmern eines Retreats in Albanien von Naturelle  Balance
Haben es genossen und werden auch im nächsten Jahr wieder teilnehmen
english:
Very nice hotel, courteous staff, and the surroundings are lovely for hiking and walking.
Also for anyone who simply wants to find some peace — we were among the participants of a retreat in Albania run by Naturelle Balance.
We enjoyed it and will be taking part again next year.

author: MT
original:
Wunderschön!
Toller Service und atemberaubende Aussicht! Zimmer sind sauber und schön eingerichtet. Das Essen schmeckt sehr lecker 👍🏼
english:
Beautiful!
Great service and breathtaking views! Rooms are clean and nicely furnished. The food tastes delicious 👍🏼

author: Kéwan
original: Pizzas moyennes, un service lunaire. Les pizzas sont affichés à l’entrée mais ne sont pas disponible à la carte une fois assis. 45 min pour réussir à commander. Aucune table debarrassée ni preparation de celle du client qui doit aller se servir pour avoir des couverts ou serviettes, malgré une 10aine de serveurs qui attendent le temps passé et baisse les yeux faisant comme si on nos interpélations n’ont pas été vu, ou encore la hausse des sourcils à chaque demande
english: Mediocre pizzas, bewildering service. The pizzas are advertised at the entrance but aren't available on the menu once you're seated. 45 minutes just to manage to order. No tables cleared and no setting of the customer's table — you have to help yourself to get cutlery or napkins, despite around ten waiters standing about, letting the time pass and looking down as if they hadn't seen us calling them, or else raising their eyebrows at every request.

author: Leonie Starmann
original: Wir waren zum Essen hier und es war ausgezeichnet! Die Tomaten hier sind traumhaft aromatisch! Tipp ist auf jedenfall der Fisch und das Hähnchen mit Reis!
english: We came here to eat and it was excellent! The tomatoes here are wonderfully flavourful! The fish and the chicken with rice are definitely recommended!

author: h brock
original: Liebenswerte Familie, tolles Essen und gut zum Entspannen in der Hängematte neben Kaninchen, einem Pferd, Schaf und der süßesten Hundewelpin.
english: Lovely family, great food, and a good place to relax in the hammock next to rabbits, a horse, a sheep and the sweetest puppy.

author: Rafaela Morini Caetano
original: Me hospedei recentemente e amei! Bujitina foi extremamente simpático e atencioso comigo e com minha amiga. O quarto é ótimo e tem uma vista linda. A comida é farta, caseira e maravilhosa. A mãe de Bujitina até embrulhou o que sobrou para levarmos para a trilha no dia seguinte. Ele cobrou 5 euros para nos levar ao início da trilha, o que foi perfeito.
english: I stayed here recently and loved it! Bujitina was extremely friendly and attentive to me and my friend. The room is great and has a beautiful view. The food is plentiful, home-made and wonderful. Bujitina's mother even wrapped up the leftovers for us to take on the trail the next day. He charged 5 euros to drive us to the trailhead, which was perfect.

author: Fugir
original:
Ficamos hospedados aqui na nossa passagem por Valbonne e que bem que o fizemos! É sem duvida sentir casa! Depois de fazermos a caminhada de Theth a Valbone! Fomos super bem recebidos pelo Albjon e sua familia! O Pai e a mae sao uns queridos que nos trataram com muito carinho! O Albjon é um amor de rapaz que foi tao bom partilhar conversas e experiencias pois viajar é mesmo isso! E ficar com estas boas memorias!
Os quartos sao super! Confortaveis! Tudo super limpo e a comida é como estar em casa e sermos comida feita pela mae! Que mais se poderia pedir! 😊 muito obrigada por tudo e principalmente de os conhecer e como fica marcada a musica da nossa viagem até ao Ferryboat! Life is life! 🫰🤍

Aproveitem cada momento! E reservem sem duvida alguma esta experiencia nesta guesthouse!
english:
We stayed here on our way through Valbona and how glad we are that we did! It truly feels like home! After doing the hike from Theth to Valbona! We were welcomed wonderfully by Albjon and his family! The father and mother are dears who treated us with great warmth! Albjon is a lovely lad and it was so good to share conversations and experiences, because that is exactly what travelling is about! And keeping these good memories!
The rooms are great! Comfortable! Everything super clean, and the food is like being at home eating your mother's cooking! What more could you ask for! 😊 Thank you so much for everything, and above all for getting to know you — and how the song from our trip to the ferryboat stays with us! Life is life! 🫰🤍

Enjoy every moment! And book this experience at this guesthouse without a moment's doubt!

author: Agnieszka Kusz
original: Jedno z tych miejsc, które zostają w pamięci na długo. Villa Prelatheth w Theth to nie tylko piękny obiekt z niesamowitym widokiem na góry, ale przede wszystkim wspaniali i niezwykle gościnni gospodarze. Od samego początku czuliśmy się bardzo mile widziani i zaopiekowani.
english: One of those places that stays in your memory for a long time. Villa Prelatheth in Theth is not only a beautiful property with an amazing view of the mountains, but above all wonderful and exceptionally hospitable hosts. From the very start we felt very welcome and well looked after.

author: Katja Mihelic
original: Prepustila sva se priporocilu izjemno prijaznega natakarja in bila navdusena: zelo zelo okusna hrana; fantasticen goveji golaz, z ogromno kolicino mesa; sarme odlicne, pire krompir kot doma narejen, okusna solata… za koneca pa domaca rakija… vrhunsko!
english: We put ourselves in the hands of an exceptionally friendly waiter's recommendation and were delighted: very, very tasty food; fantastic beef goulash with a huge amount of meat; excellent sarma (stuffed cabbage rolls), mashed potato just like home-made, tasty salad… and home-made rakija to finish… outstanding!
